deadline.value: Doctoral applications for Fall 2027 are due December 15, 2026.

gre_subject.value: The department page gives the GRE Physics rule only for Spring and Fall 2024 admissions, so no current rule is stated.

also.quote: The GRE Physics is optional for Spring and Fall 2024 admissions.

toefl_min.value: The physics department lists a suggested iBT minimum of 100, above the Institute's 88.
toefl_min.quote: iBT score: 100 | The above are the suggested minimum.

supervisor.value: The physics pages do not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: All incoming PhD students are fully supported by teaching assistant positions, per the graduate-programme page.
funding.quote: All incoming Ph.D. students are fully supported by TA positions

also.quote: PhD students are generally supported for two years on teaching assistantships, followed by two to three years of external support.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is the entry point, with 72 credits needed beyond it.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor’s degree is required with courses and grades demonstrating ability and preparation adequate for graduate study in Physics

also.quote: Seventy-two credits beyond the bachelor’s degree are required.

notes: Conflict: the graduate-programme page says all incoming PhD students are fully supported, but the PhD page says support is generally for two years then external. Astronomy & Astrophysics is covered by this PhD (special requirements for astrophysics students), so astronomy is listed in also_fields. Department GRE General rule is for 2024 only, so the university value stands. Engineering Physics PhD is on the official list but no own page was found; not saved.
